en: A colorized panoramic view over a European city surrounded by green hills and fields. In the foreground are dense trees; in the middle distance a compact old town with multi‑story buildings and church spires stretches along a river. A prominent, steep, wooded hill with a fortification or structure on its top rises near the center of the image. At the top of the card, printed in red German text, it reads: "Graz vom Rainerkogel." The overall style and tinting suggest an early 20th‑century postcard.
